description: This file defines a JSON converter for OffsetDateTime objects, enabling serialization and deserialization of OffsetDateTime instances to and from JSON within a Jersey-based REST API. It implements conversion methods and is annotated as a Spring component.

classes.name: OffsetDateTimeJsonConverter
classes.description: A Spring component implementing custom JSON serialization and deserialization for OffsetDateTime objects.

methods.name: convertToObject
methods.description: Deserializes an OffsetDateTime object from JSON string if token is a string.

methods.name: convertToJson
methods.description: Serializes an OffsetDateTime object to JSON string using ISO_OFFSET_DATE_TIME format.

methods.name: convertedType
methods.description: Returns the class type this converter handles, OffsetDateTime.
